name: flow_fixed_key_v1

generation.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, camera motion, cuts, multiple objects, flicker

cases.prompt: locked camera, a single blue rowboat moving slowly across a quiet pond, stable morning light, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single green bus moving slowly along a straight empty road, stable cloudy light, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single orange kayak gliding slowly across calm water, stable daylight, no people, no cuts
locked camera, a single white delivery van moving slowly along a straight empty street, stable overcast daylight, no people, no cuts

control.meaning: cumulative native response RMS: SINGLE46 full amount; MULTI44/46 equal halves

calibration.rule: maximum over all fixed clock paths and all three saved views per independent OFF source, plus guard
calibration.claim: functional independent-OFF calibration only; empirical rank resolution 1/3, no low-FPR claim

evidence_ceiling: unrun fixed-key candidate; reused development prompts/seeds generated afresh; historical A/B and four-bit results do not validate this fixed-marker objective or existence calibration

marker.score: component-weighted mean fixed-code clipped projection - 0.05 innovation - 0.002 event
marker.innovation_weighting: 11 windows equally weighted, q direction normalized; missing window innovation 1
marker.minimum_path_support: at least one usable >=3-group window; zero usable windows INVALID

roster_role: development mechanism validation; two independent calibration OFF cases are separate from two evaluation cases, not new-content generalization
